verdict.rationale: Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol lets merchants cryptographically verify agents. Agents sign requests with RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures aligned with web-bot-auth, tagged per interaction (agent-browser-auth / agent-payer-auth), and the signatures are bound to the merchant's domain and operation. Created/expires timestamps and nonces block replays, merchants verify against Visa's public JWKS, and an open reference implementation includes an agent-registry and a cdn-proxy verifier, which a probe confirms is published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that verification works end to end in production, and any documented graded trust tiers beyond the two interaction tags.
